title: Identification of cell pyroptosis-related gene signature for prognosis in skin cutaneous melanoma.
authors: Zuo, Shuang; Zuo, Can; Song, Jinmiao; Li, Yu; Zhai, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦皮肤黑色素瘤中细胞焦亡相关基因的预后模型构建，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是临床预后与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aims to identify a prognostic gene signature associated with cell pyroptosis and skin cutaneous melanoma (SKCM). A large amount of SKCM data was collected from the TCGA and GTEx, and differentially expressed genes were identified. By further mining public databases, genes associated with cell pyroptosis were screened to identify pyroptosis-related differentially expressed genes (PRDEGs). The biological roles of these PRDEGs were systematically characterized using Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses. Additionally, multiple SKCM prognostic models were constructed using a total of 101 machine learning algorithms in the TCGA cohort. Based on the C-index in the independent external validation cohort GSE65904, this study selected the optimal prognostic model, CoxBoost + survival-SVM. This model demonstrated favorable prognostic performance compared to that reported in previous publications. Based on this model, we developed a nomogram that integrates clinical and pathological features with the RiskScore for cell pyroptosis. Clinical correlation analysis showed that a higher RiskScore was associated with better overall survival. Additionally, GSDMD, CD274, PROM2, and GSTP1 were incorporated into the prognostic gene signature. Regulatory networks for gene features were also constructed to investigate associations among transcription factors, miRNAs, and genes.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在识别与细胞焦亡和皮肤皮肤黑色素瘤（SKCM）相关的预后基因特征。从TCGA和GTEx收集了大量SKCM数据，并鉴定了差异表达基因。通过进一步挖掘公共数据库，筛选出与细胞焦亡相关的基因，以识别焦亡相关差异表达基因（PRDEGs）。利用基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析，系统表征了这些PRDEGs的生物学作用。此外，在TCGA队列中，使用总共101种机器学习算法构建了多个SKCM预后模型。基于独立外部验证队列GSE65904中的C指数，本研究选择了最优预后模型，即CoxBoost + survival-SVM。该模型显示出比先前出版物中报告的更优的预后性能。基于此模型，我们开发了一个列线图，将临床和病理特征与细胞焦亡的RiskScore相结合。临床相关性分析显示，较高的RiskScore与更好的总生存期相关。此外，GSDMD、CD274、PROM2和GSTP1被纳入预后基因特征。还构建了基因特征的调控网络，以研究转录因子、miRNA和基因之间的关联。
